title: tabebuia pallida subsp. pentaphylla
intro: Tabebuia pallida subsp. pentaphylla, commonly known as the Pink Trumpet Tree, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Bignoniaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions such as fever, infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Tabebuia pallida subsp. pentaphylla include its ability to exhibit immunomodulatory, antiviral, and antitumor effects, making it a subject of interest in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its pharmacological properties.
